prompt:
Create a square black-and-white manga panel illustration of a very round, fluffy hamster lying on its back on a tatami mat floor in a traditional Japanese room, looking completely unmotivated and sleepy. The hamster is the central subject, huge and pear-shaped with tiny paws resting on its belly, two little feet sticking up at the bottom, small ears, half-closed eyes, and a small open mouth. Use delicate ink linework, cross-hatching, manga screentone texture, and soft fur strokes, with a cute deadpan comedic mood. Add one large irregular speech bubble above the hamster on the left containing Japanese text: やる気が
ログアウト
しています. Include exactly 3 small thought-bubble dots leading from the hamster toward the speech bubble. On the right side, place a small standing spiral-bound desk calendar sign angled in perspective with Japanese text: 本日の予定
・何もしない and a tiny doodle of a hamster face near the bottom. Show the room details: tatami weave lines and dark fabric borders, a sliding door or wall panel in the upper right with a round black pull handle, a patterned floor cushion partially visible on the left edge, and a round cushion or small plush-like mat partially visible in the lower right. Keep the composition clean and mostly white, with the hamster occupying most of the lower center, humorous and cozy. No color, no photorealism, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptZh:
创作一张方形黑白漫画分镜插画，画面中是一只非常圆润、毛茸茸的仓鼠，正仰面躺在传统日式房间的榻榻米地板上，看起来完全没有干劲且昏昏欲睡。仓鼠是画面的中心主体，体型巨大呈梨形，小爪子放在肚子上，两只小脚丫朝上，长着小耳朵、半眯着的眼睛和微张的小嘴。使用细腻的墨水线条、交叉排线、漫画网点纹理以及柔和的毛发笔触，营造出一种可爱且冷幽默的氛围。在仓鼠左上方添加一个巨大的不规则对话框，其中包含日文文本：やる気が
ログアウト
しています。从仓鼠处引出 3 个指向对话框的小型思考气泡点。在右侧，放置一个带有透视效果的小型螺旋装订桌面日历牌，上面写有日文文本：本日の予定
・何もしない，并在底部画一个仓鼠脸的小涂鸦。展示房间细节：榻榻米的纹理线条和深色布艺边缘，右上角有一扇带有圆形黑色拉手的推拉门或墙板，左侧边缘可见部分带图案的坐垫，右下角可见部分圆形坐垫或小型毛绒垫。保持构图简洁，以大面积留白为主，仓鼠占据画面下方中心位置，整体幽默且温馨。无色彩，非写实风格，无额外角色，无水印。
